interventions.cause: battery death: the battery fell from 100 % to 36 % in about 2.5 min while the charging flag flickered (as at position 39), and the robot died during a go while the agent was heading around a panel toward the ball it had seen; the agent's own go call hung. Ended by the operator; the author rules the run a failure, not invalid (the robot should have reached the ball before then)
